newsitem.title: USA: INAMED to redeem $15 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: INAMED to redeem $15 mln of notes.

text.p: INAMED Corp said Wednesday it had agreed with holders of more than two-thirds of its secured convertible notes due 1999 for the partial redemption of about $15 million in principal amount of the notes.

The redemption will be effected by returning to holders of notes that have not been converted their pro rata portion of $15 million in proceeds that were placed in escrow related with the initial issuance of notes.
These funds were initially placed in escrow as a fund for settlement of the Silicone Gel Breast Implant Products Liability Litigation, to which the company is a party.
